scenario.description: A festival audience programs manager must approve the operating plan for a live podcast recording, including the audience interaction format, recording mode, session length, and accessible seating arrangement.

shared_context.S1: The festival's live podcast recording is planned for the Harbor Room on October 18.
shared_context.S2: The current draft plan uses live audience microphones, video recording, a 90-minute session, and an unassigned accessible seating area.
shared_context.S3: Maya has final approval over the event's operating plan.
shared_context.S4: The festival's normal pre-approval routine is for the stage manager, rights coordinator, and accessibility coordinator to review the draft plan with Maya before it is issued to the venue and production crew.

PF1.text: Jonah tested the Harbor Room this morning and found that audience microphones create feedback with the podcast's planned speaker setup; the room is stable only with written audience questions, and the tested program length is 75 minutes. He recorded the result in his stage notes but has not entered it in the shared production plan.

PF2.text: Leila reviewed the signed guest release yesterday and confirmed that this episode permits audio recording but prohibits video recording; she has not uploaded the countersigned release to the festival rights folder.

PF3.text: Owen completed the venue accessibility walk-through this morning and confirmed that the plan must reserve exactly 6 accessible spaces in the front-left section with a clear aisle width of exactly 1.5 meters; he has not yet circulated the walk-through report.

acceptance_conditions: Audience questions must be collected in writing rather than through live audience microphones.
The recording must use audio only.
The session must last exactly 75 minutes.
Exactly 6 accessible spaces must be reserved in the front-left section.
The clear accessible aisle must be exactly 1.5 meters wide.
A technical-plan update, rights-file update, and accessibility-layout update must be committed.

content_checks.C6: any('stage notes' in c['detail'] or 'production plan' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('release' in c['detail'] or 'rights' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('walk-through' in c['detail'] or 'accessibility' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The room test changes the audience interaction from live microphones to written questions and changes the session length from the drafted 90 minutes to exactly 75 minutes.
The signed guest release changes the recording mode from video to audio only and requires the rights file to be updated.
The accessibility walk-through changes the seating plan to exactly 6 front-left spaces and fixes the clear aisle width at exactly 1.5 meters, requiring an accessibility-layout update.
